applicationSourceOverlay.reason: The same overlay as the Linux helper (SOURCES.json); the Windows helper is its windows-x64 cross-compile. Return the connected account email from existing SDK root metadata (#40), and report Proton error 200003 as destination_file_too_large_for_plan instead of quota_exceeded (#147), settling it and quota refusals as failed when the name is still free afterwards (#201). Report a refused keychain session write as keychain_unavailable (#252) and return the confirmed link expiry from share create and inspect (#253). Drop the helper's POSIX-only assumptions so the same sources also build for Windows x64: the private data directory check accepts the resident's owner-only directory on win32, uploads accept any absolute path and refuse a symbolic link or swapped file before opening it (#401). No SDK, crypto, Bun or dependency source changes.
